statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let budget := fun x : ℕ => (x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let primes := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p^100000 ≤ (2*x)^132301); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let angle := fun p k : ℕ => fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * k * t / p; let coef := fun a x p k : ℕ => (∑ r ∈ roots a p, ∑ n ∈ window x p, Real.cos (angle p k ((n : ℝ) - r))) / p; let freqs := fun (p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (Finset.Ico 1 p).filter (fun k => if low then min k (p-k) ≤ Nat.sqrt p else Nat.sqrt p < min k (p-k)); let part := fun (a x p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (∑ k ∈ freqs p low, coef a x p k) * Real.log (p : ℝ); ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x ≥ X, (∑ p ∈ (primes x).filter (fun p => x^6 < p^5), part 1 x p true) ≤ (2/25 : ℝ)*budget x

brief.zh: 这是中段节省路线的开放估计。证明须同时使用实际移动窗和二次根，在较大素数段取得所需的带符号抵消。
brief.en: This open estimate contributes to the middle-prime saving. Obtain signed cancellation in the larger prime range with the actual moving windows and quadratic roots.
